data.title: KLN Logistics Group Shareholders Approve Revised Framework Agreement Caps
data.description:
An update from KLN Logistics Group Limited ( (HK:0636) ) is now available.

At a special general meeting held on 20 November 2026, shareholders approved all three ordinary resolutions by poll, with 691,379,502 votes, or 100%, in favour and none against. The resolutions ratified and approved revised annual caps under the 2024 CGSA, KLN Logistics Services and SF Logistics framework agreements, and authorised directors to implement the related arrangements.

SF Holding and its associates, holding about 51.52% of issued shares, abstained, as did the share-award scheme trustee. data.title: Vitasoy Reports 8% Rise in Interim Attributable Profit
data.description:
Vitasoy International Holdings ( (HK:0345) ) has shared an update.

Vitasoy International Holdings offers soy and plant milk beverages and tofu, with businesses in the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong SAR, Macau SAR, Australia, New Zealand and Singapore, as well as exports. Its Hong Kong operation has leadership in soy and plant milk beverages, while Singapore demand includes tofu and beverages.

Vitasoy reported revenue of HK$3.337 billion for the six months ended 30th September 2026, up 3% year on year, while gross profit margin rose to 51.9% and profit attributable to equity shareholders increased 8% to HK$184.755 million. Revenue growth was supported by foreign-exchange translation; lower commodity costs and manufacturing efficiency helped margin, partly offset by higher trade promotional expenses.

Chinese Mainland revenue declined slightly in local currency but retained a double-digit operating profit margin; Hong Kong performance was supported by soy and plant milk leadership, partly offset by weaker Macau demand, while Australia and New Zealand recorded lower Australian-dollar sales and a higher operating loss. Singapore revenue grew on demand for tofu and beverages. The group repurchased 5,602,000 shares for approximately HK$36 million and declared an interim dividend of HK4.0 cents per share.

data.title: Jinhui Provides Details on Three Equity-Based Structured Notes
data.description:
Jinhui Holdings Co. Ltd. ( (HK:0137) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Jinhui Holdings provided additional details about its acquisition of three equity-based structured notes issued by CSI Financial Products Limited, an indirectly owned CITIC Securities subsidiary that issues structured products and conducts derivative transactions. NOTE-1 and NOTE-2 pay fixed coupons linked to underlying shares and may be redeemed early at 100% of principal plus applicable interest if knock-out conditions are met.

If held to maturity, the notes are redeemed at 100% of principal plus interest when underlying prices meet strike prices; otherwise, the company may receive shares at strike prices, with downside exposure limited to the relevant principal. NOTE-3 is a CNH5 million fixed-coupon note linked to the CSI Smallcap 500 Index, with automatic termination if the index closes at or above the applicable knock-out barrier on an observation date.

data.title: BrainAurora DELIGHT Study on Cognitive Training Published in eClinicalMedicine
data.description:
The latest update is out from BrainAurora Medical Technology Limited ( (HK:6681) ).

A multicenter, double-blind, randomized controlled DELIGHT study involving 217 patients across 11 hospitals in the PRC was published in eClinicalMedicine on 18 November 2026. It evaluated 12 weeks of multi-domain adaptive computerized cognitive training against training focused on perception and attention in patients with hypertension and mild cognitive impairment.

The release said the intervention improved cognitive function, enhanced connectivity in attention, executive-control and episodic-memory networks, and increased hippocampal gray-matter density. Compared with the control group, patients also had lower diastolic blood pressure, more stable heart rates and lower rate pressure product, findings the release said support a brain-heart co-treatment approach and non-pharmacological hypertension intervention.
